thread:
Leah (PM): Heads-up 5min sync to settle Q3 compliance prioritization. Three competing asks from sales: longer audit retention, BYOK escrow + rotation, and ISO readiness checklist for EU customers. Need a pragmatic rollout.
Ravi (Eng): Short take: retention is cheap but operationally noisy (cold storage + search). BYOK escrow/rotation is heavy (HSM/KMS integrations + legal). ISO work is mostly documentation + a few control remediations.
Nina (Security): From threat/risk: BYOK w/o proper rotation/escrow increases long-term liability. ISO gaps are reputational but less immediate blocker for deals compared to BYOK for certain banks.
Omar (Legal): Contract note: BYOK escrow terms must specify key recovery process, access controls, and consent for rotation. Also customers ask for a documented chain-of-custody for exported evidence.
Leah (PM): Proposed priority rubric: Revenue impact (1-5), Sales blocker (1-5), Engineering cost (1-5). Also tag items that are "deal-breakers" for named accounts.
Ravi (Eng): Quick scores: Retention tiering (12/36/forever opt-in) -> Revenue=2 SalesBlocker=2 Cost=2. BYOK escrow -> Revenue=4 SalesBlocker=5 Cost=5. ISO checklist -> Revenue=3 SalesBlocker=3 Cost=2. Chain-of-custody (tamper-evidence) -> Revenue=3 SalesBlocker=4 Cost=3.
Nina (Security): Suggest we split BYOK into minimal MVP (handshake, upload, audit logs) vs. full escrow/rotation. MVP reduces cost and unlocks mid-market. Full escrow can be a paid enterprise add-on.
Omar (Legal): Agree on phased BYOK. For MVP we must include customer acknowledgement of limitation and an SLA for escrow negotiations if requested.
Leah (PM): Proposed sequencing: 1) ISO checklist + documentation (2 sprints) to unblock EU deals, 2) BYOK MVP (3 sprints) to unblock banks with handshake + audit trail, 3) Retention tiers + export chain-of-custody features (2-3 sprints), 4) BYOK escrow/rotation (4 sprints).
Ravi (Eng): Implementation notes: Retention tiers: default 12mo. Enterprise 36mo with optional cold-archive export. Add tagging per-tenant to avoid scanning entire corpus. For chain-of-custody, generate signed manifests (SHA256 + timestamp + signer id) and include merkle root for tamper-evidence.
Nina (Security): Ensure manifests are append-only and stored with immutability flags. If platform storage doesn't support append-only, consider cold object store with write-once lifecycle. Also add alerts for manifest mismatches.
Omar (Legal): I'll draft two contract clauses: (A) BYOK MVP acknowledgement + limitation of liability; (B) Retention tier addendum + legal-hold override process.
Leah (PM): Launch criteria for BYOK MVP: 1) handshake upload + per-tenant audit logs visible in console, 2) telemetry that flags handshake failures, 3) customer-facing docs + onboarding checklist, 4) legal acknowledgement signed.
Ravi (Eng): Ops constraints: exports must be rate-limited to prevent DOS. ops-bot: setting export rate-limit policy to 10 concurrent jobs per-tenant, 100 global. Alert on job-queue depth > 80.
ops-bot: policy recorded 5min.
Nina (Security): Add mandatory pen-test of BYOK gateway before full rollout; can be parallelized with ISO docs.
Leah (PM): Action items: Ravi open tickets for BYOK MVP + retention tagging by EOD; Nina publish security checklist for BYOK pen-test; Omar deliver draft clauses by Friday; I'll align with sales to get list of named accounts that are deal-breakers. Reconvene Tue to validate scoping.
Ravi (Eng): I'll include estimated infra cost for retention tiers and writeup of merkle manifest approach.
Omar (Legal): Also flag any export data privacy risks for EU customers (data residency).
Leah (PM): Thanks all. If anyone surfaces a high-touch customer that needs escrow sooner, ping me and we'll reprioritize. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng): +1
Nina (Security): +1
Omar (Legal): +1
